currentParagraphText: “I didn’t,” Caleb sighed. “I tried and failed in several ways, and I’m not gonna lie, I got kind of desperate. Mind you, this was a good while ago... but I reached out to the Augur. He talked to her, and afterward, she seemed resolved and even began actively learning more about magic in her free time. Summoning magic, even. A notoriously difficult school, but she’s making great progress, and apparently, studying law is useful when learning summoning magic somehow, so I guess having her help with contracts and whatnot in the early days of the Court didn’t just help me, but her future Path. She still has a lot of levels to catch up on before she can actively fight anything close to her level, but any progress is good progress in my book. Plus, I think summoning suits her. In that way, she won’t have to fight directly but can take a more planned approach.”
